name: codex-enhancer
description: Proof of concept that loads an external runtime into a test copy of Codex Desktop.

scripts.detect: npm run build --silent && node bin/codex-enhancer.js detect
scripts.install: npm run build --silent && node bin/codex-enhancer.js install
scripts.uninstall: npm run build --silent && node bin/codex-enhancer.js uninstall
scripts.status: npm run build --silent && node bin/codex-enhancer.js status
scripts.launch: npm run build --silent && node bin/codex-enhancer.js launch
